category.name: Kinematics & Motion
category.description: Study of motion of objects without considering the forces causing the motion.

lessons.name: Speed & Velocity
lessons.description: Speed is the scalar rate at which an object covers distance. Velocity is vector speed in a given direction.

variables.name: Distance / Displacement
variables.description: Total path length or linear displacement (SI unit: m)

worked_example.problem: A car travels a distance of 150 meters in 10 seconds. Calculate its average speed.
steps: Identify given values: distance d = 150 m, time t = 10 s

validation.error_message: Time must be greater than zero.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Speed measures how fast an object moves. Average speed equals total distance divided by total time elapsed.

lessons.name: Acceleration
lessons.description: Rate of change of velocity with respect to time.

variables.name: Acceleration
variables.description: Rate of velocity change (SI unit: m/s²)

variables.name: Final Velocity
variables.description: Velocity at end of interval (SI unit: m/s)

variables.name: Initial Velocity
variables.description: Velocity at start of interval (SI unit: m/s)

worked_example.problem: A train accelerates from 10 m/s to 30 m/s in 5 seconds. Calculate its acceleration.
steps: Identify values: u = 10 m/s, v = 30 m/s, t = 5 s
Change in velocity: v - u = 30 - 10 = 20 m/s

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Acceleration occurs whenever an object speeds up, slows down (deceleration), or changes direction.
